name: session-control

session-control.storagePath.description: Folder (relative to workspace root) where chat sessions are saved.

enumDescriptions: Prefer VS Code Copilot chat storage for manual provider flows.
Prefer local Codex session transcripts for manual provider flows.
Prefer Cursor Agent transcript JSONL files for manual provider flows.
Prefer local Claude Code JSONL transcripts for manual provider flows.
session-control.save.provider.description: Provider preference for manual flows that do not prompt. This setting does not control auto-save; use session-control.autoSave.providers to choose auto-save providers.

session-control.copilot.homePath.description: Optional GitHub Copilot CLI home directory. When empty, Session Control uses COPILOT_HOME or ~/.copilot.

session-control.codex.homePath.description: Optional Codex home directory for importing local Codex sessions. When empty, Session Control uses CODEX_HOME or ~/.codex.

session-control.claudeCode.homePath.description: Optional Claude Code home directory for importing local Claude Code sessions. When empty, Session Control uses CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR or ~/.claude.

session-control.cursor.userDataPath.description: Optional Cursor user data directory for legacy workspace chatSessions JSONL import. When empty, Session Control uses the default Cursor user data location for this OS.

session-control.cursor.projectsPath.description: Optional Cursor projects directory for importing Agent transcript JSONL files. When empty, Session Control uses ~/.cursor/projects.

session-control.autoSaveOnChatResponse.description: Enable workspace-scoped auto-save after each detected response or transcript update. Providers are selected by session-control.autoSave.providers.

session-control.autoSave.providers.description: Providers monitored while workspace-scoped auto-save is enabled. Defaults to all supported saved-session providers.

session-control.includeInGitignore.description: Add the storage folder to .gitignore. By default sessions are tracked in source control.

session-control.resume.maxTurns.description: Maximum number of turns to inject as context when resuming a saved session.

enumDescriptions: Summarize older turns into a preamble using the LLM, then include the most recent turns verbatim.
Silently drop the oldest turns until within the limit.
Load only the most recent N turns with a note about omitted turns.

Keep the most recent N turns, then fill the remaining resume.maxContextChars with the earlier turns TypeSafe scores as most relevant to your follow-up, in turn order. Falls back to summarize when TypeSafe is off or unavailable.
session-control.resume.overflowStrategy.description: What to do when a session exceeds resume.maxTurns or resume.maxContextChars.

session-control.resume.maxContextChars.description: Hard cap on total characters injected as context when resuming. Overflow is handled by resume.overflowStrategy.

enumDescriptions: Open the saved session's origin agent chat window when possible.
Always use the VS Code chat participant resume flow.
session-control.resume.target.description: Default target for Resume This Session in Chat. Origin-agent opens Codex, Claude Code, Cursor, or Copilot based on the saved provider when available. Use Continue This Session In... to pick any installed assistant instead.

copilot.description: Command ID used to open Copilot chat for resume.

codex.description: Command ID used to open Codex chat for resume.

cursor.description: Command ID used to open Cursor agent chat for resume.

claude-code.description: Command ID used to open Claude Code chat for resume.

session-control.resume.providerCommands.description: Provider-specific chat command IDs that override Session Control's built-in resume command discovery, for both origin resume and Continue This Session In....

session-control.save.maxFileSize.patternErrorMessage: Must be a size like '500kb' or '1mb'.
session-control.save.maxFileSize.description: Maximum size per saved session file. Sessions exceeding this are handled by save.overflowStrategy.

enumDescriptions: Split the session into multiple part files linked by metadata.
Drop the oldest turns until the session fits within the size limit.
Save the session as-is and show a warning notification.
session-control.save.overflowStrategy.description: What to do when a saved session file exceeds save.maxFileSize.

session-control.save.stripToolOutput.description: Strip verbose tool call outputs (e.g. file contents, terminal output) from saved turns to reduce file size. Tool call names and summaries are preserved.

session-control.save.useTimestampInFileN.description: Include UTC timestamp in saved session file names. When disabled, files use title-only names and add an id suffix if a duplicate title already exists.

session-control.save.maxSavedSessions.description: Maximum number of session files to keep in the storage folder. 0 means unlimited. When exceeded, the oldest sessions are handled by save.pruneAction.

enumDescriptions: Move the oldest sessions to a .archive/ subfolder.
session-control.save.pruneAction.description: What to do with the oldest sessions when save.maxSavedSessions is exceeded.

session-control.typesafe.enabled.description: Enable TypeSafe System One judgments (Jev) for intent routing, analysis triage, resume context selection, and report verification.

session-control.typesafe.model.description: TypeSafe System One model used for judgments. Defaults to jev-latest.

session-control.typesafe.sessionIndicato.markdownDescription: Show Jev indicator badges in Saved Sessions: ◆ knowledge worth harvesting, ▲ a workflow that should become an AI skill, ★ both. Only active when `#session-control.typesafe.enabled#` is on, a TypeSafe API key is set, and TypeSafe consent has been given.

session-control.typesafe.sessionIndicato.description: Minimum Jev probability (0-1) for flagging a saved session as a knowledge-harvest candidate.
Minimum Jev probability (0-1) for flagging a saved session as an AI-skill candidate.

routing.description: Enable TypeSafe intent routing for chat prompts without a slash command.

triage.description: Enable TypeSafe triage and scoring of candidate sessions before full analysis.

resumeSelection.description: Enable TypeSafe relevance-ranked turn selection when resuming a session.

reportVerification.description: Enable TypeSafe verification of analysis report recommendations against evidence.

session-control.typesafe.features.description: Per-feature toggles for TypeSafe System One judgments when session-control.typesafe.enabled is true.

session-control.pro.polar.organizationId.description: Polar organization ID used to validate Session Control Pro license keys. Defaults to the production Session Control organization; override only for Polar sandbox testing together with pro.polar.apiBaseUrl.

session-control.pro.polar.apiBaseUrl.description: Polar API base URL used to validate Session Control Pro license keys. Use https://sandbox-api.polar.sh for Polar sandbox testing.

session-control-pro.search.additionalRoo.description: Additional workspace roots to include when searching saved sessions.

session-control-pro.search.maxResults.description: Maximum number of saved-session search results to return.

session-control-pro.search.includeToolCa.description: Include tool-call content when searching saved sessions.

session-control-pro.gitSync.remoteUrl.description: Clone URL (SSH or HTTPS) of a private Git repository you own that Push and Pull Saved Sessions to Git use. Empty disables Git sync. Machine scope: only your user setting is read, never a workspace value. Do not put credentials in the URL; Git uses your credential manager or SSH agent.

session-control-pro.gitSync.branch.description: Branch of the Git sync repository that holds saved sessions. Machine scope: only your user setting is read, never a workspace value.

session-control-pro.gitSync.workspaceKey.description: Folder name this workspace uses inside the Git sync repository. When empty, it is derived from the workspace's origin remote, or from the workspace folder name when there is no origin. Set it so the same project maps to the same folder on every machine.

languageModelTools.name: session-control_listSessions
languageModelTools.userDescription: List chat sessions saved by Session Control in this workspace.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Lists chat sessions that Session Control saved in the open workspace folders, newest first. Returns JSON with each session's id, title, date (ISO saved time), git branch, short commit, turn count, origin provider, and workspace folder. Use this when the user asks which sessions are saved, or to find the id of a session before calling session-control_resumeSession. Optionally filter by a title, id, or branch substring. When the user wants to resume a session without naming one, show the list and let them choose before resuming.

query.description: Optional case-insensitive substring matched against session title, id, or git branch.

limit.description: Maximum number of sessions to return (default 20, maximum 100).

languageModelTools.name: session-control_resumeSession
languageModelTools.userDescription: Load a saved Session Control chat session as context.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Loads a chat session saved by Session Control and returns its transcript as text so you can continue that conversation. Pass the session id from session-control_listSessions, or a title; titles are fuzzy matched and ambiguous matches return candidate ids. If the user gives an exact id, call this directly without listing sessions first. If a title is ambiguous, ask the user which candidate they mean rather than picking one. The transcript is trimmed to the user's resume.maxTurns and resume.maxContextChars settings, with a note when earlier turns are omitted; tell the user when that happens. Use this when the user asks to resume, continue, or reload a previous or saved session.

session.description: Saved session id (preferred) or title to resume.

languageModelTools.name: session-control_analyzeSessions
languageModelTools.userDescription: Analyze saved Session Control chats and save a recommendations report.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Runs Session Control's saved-chat analysis (the same flow as @session-control /analyze) and saves a markdown report of recommendations for repository AI control files such as AGENTS.md and .github/copilot-instructions.md. Omit timeframe to analyze every saved session not yet analyzed; pass timeframe 24h, 7d, or 30d to analyze sessions saved in that window, with onlyUnanalyzed to skip ones already analyzed. Uses a GitHub Copilot model through direct language-model requests and can take a minute or more. Returns JSON with the report status, the saved report path, and the verified/unsupported/demoted recommendation counts; when no report is saved, returns the reason instead.

timeframe.description: Analyze sessions saved in the last 24 hours, 7 days, or 30 days. Omit to analyze all sessions that have not been analyzed yet.

onlyUnanalyzed.description: With a timeframe, skip sessions that were already analyzed (default false). Ignored without a timeframe.

languageModelTools.name: session-control_getImplementationPrompt
languageModelTools.userDescription: Get the implementation prompt for a saved Session Control analysis report.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Returns Session Control's implementation prompt (the same instructions @session-control /implement hands to a coding agent) for the latest saved analysis report, or for the report named by path. You are the implementer: after calling this, follow the returned instructions yourself in the current workspace, starting by reading the report file it names. The prompt limits the work to repository AI control files such as AGENTS.md, .github/copilot-instructions.md, and skill files, and lists the recommendations the report's verification left actionable. Use this when the user asks to implement, apply, or act on an analysis report or its recommendations. When no report exists, returns a message saying to run session-control_analyzeSessions first.

report.description: Optional report path: the reportFilePath or reportPath returned by session-control_analyzeSessions, a workspace-relative path, or the report file name. Omit to use the latest saved report.
